Collins Aerospace, part of RTX, develops aerospace and defense products and technologies. The Embedded Software Engineer I will design, develop, integrate, and verify embedded software solutions while collaborating with hardware, systems, and FPGA engineers. The role also involves implementing and testing software, contributing to the full software development lifecycle, and working in an agile team environment.

Responsibilities
As a Software Engineer I on our team, you will play a key role in the design, development, integration, and verification of our embedded software solutions
You will be a part of a team that is developing new and innovative products for our customers’ mission
You will develop your skills with software application tools and languages such as Rust, C ++, and Python
You will impact the team positively by demonstrating your ability to implement and test software solutions
You will have opportunities to learn about cryptography, waveform & networking protocols, embedded devices, DevSecOps, command & control, project engineering
You will gain experience working with an agile team
You will gain experience in the full software development lifecycle
You can take flight to the next level of your career by becoming a subject matter expert
